description: Put every task file's parent in ONE encoding, and every link-valued `parent:` / `blockedBy` reference onto the target task's id. A task file records its parent either as a `parent:` task id or as a wikilink inside `projects:` (the TaskNotes plugin's convention); both of THOSE are read, and the vault's `parent_encoding` setting only decides what a WRITE emits — so a vault whose setting changed keeps its existing files in the old form. A `parent:` or `blockedBy` value holding a LINK is read by nothing and connects nothing until this verb converts it, and a raw 40-hex corpus id in any dependency (`blockedBy`, `dependsOn::` or `⛔`, task file or inline line) becomes the target's user id (a target with none is given one; a raw id naming no task is reported and left). It never changes WHICH parent a task has or which task it depends on, never touches a file already in the target form, and reports (rather than rewrites) a file whose reference is dangling or whose two encodings name different tasks. Pass to:'parentField' or to:'projectsLink' to override the vault's configured encoding, dry_run:true to preview. Use `doctor` to find out whether a vault needs it.

dry_run.description:
Preview only: report which files would change, and why the rest
would not, without writing. The result carries `dry_run: true`.

to.description:
The encoding to converge on: `parentField` (a dedicated `parent:`
key) or `projectsLink` (a wikilink inside `projects:`, the
TaskNotes plugin's convention). Omit to use this vault's own
configured encoding — `get_dialect` reports which that is. Any
other value is an error, never a silent fall-back to the
configured one.

name: normalize_references
